keyFindings.description: interestReadDidNotAnswer is an allowlist, and it misses a read that did not answer. When nats.go's write buffer reaches its 32 KiB limit, natsWriter.flush returns the socket's raw write error (nats.go:2143-2145); publish (:4406) and requestWithContext (context.go:60-62) pass it through unwrapped as a *net.OpError (broken pipe, connection reset). It matches no sentinel, so GET /v1/sessions lists that session with no topics, the answer the ruling and the comments rule out for an unanswered read, while GET /v1/registry/<id> answers the same error with a 503. Fix: classify as answered only the answers the code names (nats.ErrKeyNotFound, bus.ErrRefused, store.ErrMalformedInterest) and treat every other error as a read that did not answer, as /v1/registry already does; the LegacyKeys test keeps passing.

False statements. The comment at api.go:664-665 says every other error is one the bus or this client answered; docs/architecture.md:57 says a connection that could not carry the request is always a 503; AGENTS.md's /v1/sessions row says any other error means the bus answered. All three are false for the case above. The interestReadDidNotAnswer comment (api.go:702-706) and AGENTS.md also name nats.ErrTimeout and nats.ErrConnectionReconnecting, which this read never returns: getJSContextOpts always sets a ctx, so the read takes requestWithContext, and ErrConnectionReconnecting is returned only by Conn.Drain.
